title: Wolf Whistle
start: Talk to Pikkupstix in his house in Taverley.

rewards.t: Access to the troll cave with mountain trolls in it

steps.t: Talk to Pikkupstix in his summoning shop just north-west of Taverley's east entrance. [Chat: 2 Do you have a quest for me? › Accept]
Head to south of the Taverley lodestone, enter the well, and watch the short cutscene. [Chat: 1 Look, I'll just go and take a look myself...]
Talk to Pikkupstix back at the east side of Taverley. [Chat: 2 Bowloftrix has been kidnapped by trolls! › 5 I think I had better go.]
Go upstairs at Pikkupstix's house and search the cluttered drawers in the north-west corner.
Go to the pet shop south of Pikkupstix and ask the owner about white hare meat. [Chat: 1 Ask about the white hare meat.]
Go back towards the well and go west onto White Wolf Mountain.
p: The trolls scared of the wolpertinger.
Bowloftrix thanks the adventurer for saving him.

steps.t: Take the eastern path and search Stikklebrix's body.
Talk to Pikkupstix after the items are obtained. [Chat: 2 I need to ask you something about the quest...]
Infuse the pouch using the obelisk on the eastern side of his house.
Talk to him again. [Chat: 2 I need to ask you something about the quest... › 1 I made the giant wolpertinger pouch!]
Go west back to the well and talk to Scalectrix (make sure you dismiss your pet if you have one out).
